{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：星命溯源五卷，不著編輯者名氏。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745145919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"第一卷為通元遺書，雜録唐張果之說，凡三","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745162303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745162303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"第二卷為果、憕問答，稱明李憕遇張果所","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745178687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"口授，凡四篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745178687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"第三卷為元妙經觧，稱張果撰，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745195071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"元鄭希誠註。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745195071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"第四卷為觀星要訣；第五卷為","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745211455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017567957401651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星心傳口訣補遺。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745211455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"均不云誰作。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745227839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其題詞，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745244223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"似要訣為鄭希誠編，補遺又術士掇拾，增希","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745244223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"誠所未備也。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745244223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"考明皇雜録載果多神怪之迹，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745260607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"不言其知禄命。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745260607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"獨是編以五星推命之學依","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745276991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"托于果，術者遂以果老五星自名一家。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745276991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"考韓","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745293375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"愈作李虚中墓誌，稱其推命尚止用年、月、日，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745293375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"不用時，則開元、天寳之間且無八字，似不應","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745293375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"有五星。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745293375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"然王充論衡稱：天施氣而衆星布精，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745309759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017619522060326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"天所施氣而衆星之氣在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745309759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"人禀氣而","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745326143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"生，含氣而長，得貴則貴，得賤則賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745326143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"貴或秩有","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745342527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"髙下，富或貲有多少，皆星位尊𤰞大小之所","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745342527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"授也。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745342527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"是漢末巳以星位言禄命。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745358911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"又韓愈三星","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745375295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"行云：我生之辰，月宿南斗，牛奮其角，箕張其","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745375295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"口。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745375295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"杜牧自作墓誌銘曰：余生于角星昴畢，于","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745391679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"角為第八宫，曰病厄宫，亦曰八殺宫，土星在","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745391679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"焉，火星繼木星王。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745391679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"楊晞曰：木在張，于角為第","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745408063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017579298816051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"十一福徳宫，木為福徳大君子，救其旁，無虞","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745408063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745408063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：自湖守不週歳遷舍人，木還福于角，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745424447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745424447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"土火還死于角，宜哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745440831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"是唐時實以五星","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745457215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"宫度推休咎，其托名于果，亦有所因爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745457215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"希誠","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745473599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"自署其官曰主簿，其籍曰瑞安，其號曰滄洲，","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745473599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"始末未詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745473599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"憕自稱中都人，其遇果在嘉靖二","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745489983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"年九月，尤怪妄不足辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745489983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，術家務神其說","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745506367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745506367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"然世所傳五星之書，以此為鼻祖，别有","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745522751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017600224182313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂果老星宗者，葢因此本而廣之。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745522751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"其後又","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745539135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"有天官五星術，與此頗異。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745539135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"據理而論，化氣當","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745555519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"從天官，正氣當從果老，二家之術可互叅。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745555519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745571903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"論星度乘除生尅，及兼取值年神煞，亦未可","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745571903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"盡廢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745571903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"乾隆四十六年十二月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"7679037017745588287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

679035936525238313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"今左旋于","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525254697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"亢，昨夜火逼金龍太白，今午合退于辰，必有大難。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525254697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"我當","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525271081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"化𧰼太乙以𧟄之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525271081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"言未巳，明皇果召試之，飲以毒酒三","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525287465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"杯，醺然若醉。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525287465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：非佳酒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525303849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"頃之，齒皆焦黒，果以所","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525320233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"執鐵如意撃之，皆落。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525320233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"假寐少時，齒復生。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525336617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"時神其事，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525353001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"李憕再拜受教，問曰：福禄拱夾，其命必貴耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525353001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"必富耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525369385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"先","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525385769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635761675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"生曰：是淳風小兒之誣言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525385769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"五星六曜，資我者吉，傷我","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525402153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"者凶，亦隨嵗而𠮓乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525402153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"因取王勃命視之，勃命坐翼水退","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525418537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"朝陽于軫木作援炁，又滋培奎璧之次，故其人秀而善","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525418537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"屬文，以名立身，以名敗身，水為禄主故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525418537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"金曜朝斗限","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525434921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"行，井木犴對照受傷，羅孛一鋒一刄，互争勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525434921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"是年屬","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525451305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，陽刄又臨，惡死無疑，子其待之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525451305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"後果溺死，二十九嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"憕又引天","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525467689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"綱集曰：一生侘傺 {"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：煽熾怕傷金位，此天綱之言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525582377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"假使我命火，必","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525598761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"不為忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525598761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"適楊國忠丑時生子，命坐酉夘，火羅兩夾，一為天","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525615145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"雄煞，一為刄星，又是咸池之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525615145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"憕舉問，先生曰：昨夜客","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525631529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"曜犯金女，此火羅之驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525631529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"是子之夀，不出今日。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525647913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"果其夜","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525664297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"不收。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525664297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"國忠神之，請詳巳命。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525680681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：是命泊處雖得卦氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525697065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017626140672026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"身元坐刄，而刃反起逼命位。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525697065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"吾知其富且貴者，以度主","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525713449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"禄主起，從陽於福徳宫而釣起，又生本元。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525713449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"然貴則貴矣，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525729833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"苐未保其令終也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525729833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"李憕曰：請問所以。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525746217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"先生作色曰：後自","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525762601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"知之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525762601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"天寳間，果為亂軍所殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：火纒酉夘，天綱指為火燒牛角，火命人不為忌，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525778985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525778985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火即我也，我燒牛角，乃我勢盛，何傷？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525795369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"賦曰：火入","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525811753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"金鄉，此命早抛兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525811753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"火命不為忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525828137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘木子、土巳、金寅、","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525844521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"水戌，皆可準此例。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525844521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017596738650153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：日，火也；月，水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525860905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"四日度坐命，晝生忌火，羅是也，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525877289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"前已定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525877289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"四月度坐命，夜生怕土計亦同此例。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525893673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"因指張","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525910057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"巡命示之曰：彼命坐心月，狐命限到張度，計屬刃星迫","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525910057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"於前，土為劍鋒逼於後，使其背行稍可，否則徃來交鬬，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525910057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"能脱此乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525910057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"時方貴盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525926441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：貴盛可勝天乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525942825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳末嵗，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525959209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"刃煞復隨流計加沓，必死兵下。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936525959209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":102,"lineType":2,"content":"後果死禄山兵下。","logicSentenceId":"0"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"李憕試一人命，命坐夘宫，氐土度金守照，金為飛亷主","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529760298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"星，何以能延？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529760298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：爾乃專于局見，而不知甲辰火命人，豈","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529776682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"有懼于飛亷金乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529776682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"若木命人，的不能延。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529793066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"今限行井木飛","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529809450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017598177411124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"符、病符、月宫符同守照，又加流星火煞，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529809450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":218,"lineType":2,"content":"一家大煞，正戌、二已、三午、四未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"五寅、六夘、七辰、八亥、九子、十丑、十一申、十二酉，順行與前大戾。月宫符，正月午，二月未，順數十二月，至己上為止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"得無官災乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529809450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"問之，此人已在囹圄之中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529825834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：晝生太陽，此命火羅夾拱，火又為陽刃煞星，羅","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529842218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"㬋鋒刃，不早喪父，亦主偏盲。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529842218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"憕問曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529858602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：日是父也，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529874986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"月是母也，亦目之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529874986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生主太陰，忌主亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529891370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"見土是","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529907754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529907754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：慈心敬順，善曜居命位之鄉；獰然凶頑，惡星纒","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529924138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"命位之旁。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529924138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃在命，性必横。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529940522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"加天雄者，性必雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529956906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"唯官星","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529973290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之，","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529973290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":238,"lineType":2,"content":"官禄主忌會天雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：六甲之例，古未有也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936529989674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"軒轅時，大撓所定五行納","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530006058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"音，古無有也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530006058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"顓帝時，洪範所究四七星宿，古未之有。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530022442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530038826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"綱屬諸星象而知之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530038826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"古人惟齊七政，四曜何得同叅？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530055210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"七","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530071594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"政猶人中之君子也，四曜乃餘氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530071594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"李憕請問餘氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530087978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"先","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530104362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"生指星璣之語曰：水之餘，孛也；水之餘，炁也；火之餘，羅","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530104362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"也；土之餘，計也。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530104362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"寧五星犯餘氣，莫餘氣犯五星，禍患尤大。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530120746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017567957565491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：汝知孤寡命乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530137130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：敢請先生指示。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530153514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"殊愉命曰：此","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530169898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"命格局善，然妻宫在亥，金在巳，妻宫壞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530169898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"惟木得垣，妻","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530186282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有而不免鼓盆之歎。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530186282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆凖此例。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530202666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：子知萬乘主乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530219050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘主與下貴不侔，必夾拱隂","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530235434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，必五曜連珠。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530235434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"令大唐天子乙酉命，其年五星𤨔拱天","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530251818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"門，日月分躔危璧，命坐室宿觀之。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530251818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"憕看果然。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530268202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：限","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530284586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"至角木，蛟則危矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679035936530284586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"繼而曰：角木雖危，必有離宫之厄，翼","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721137727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"火不出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721137727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"憕問所從，孛壞翼，大蛇角之四度，對照戌宫","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721154111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996178472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"之金。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721154111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"五曜連珠，金婁水壁從陽，木火土輔太陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721170495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"今限行","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721186879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"氐土貉，李林甫當國，事可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721186879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"先生論泰階，憕問曰：淳風晝火夜土，忌曜之說，可得聞","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721203263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721203263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"先生曰：四火懼見漂流。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721219647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"四火坐命則忌水，得土為之","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721236031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"援曜。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721236031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"如四土坐命，則忌木，得火益滋土勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721252415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"如土曜謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721268799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"忌曜，曜為我度，主飛起朝陽，又謂之忌曜，可乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721268799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"先生言畢，拂袂長嘯而去，莫知所終。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721285183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"李憕記是語而編","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721301567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"之目曰禀賦分金。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721301567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之分金者，别人生貴賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721317951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"後學融","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721334335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996194856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹此理，應如符劵，以决人之休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721334335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"昔時大仙觀命觀星，皆非泛論。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721367103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"人之命賦稟天地造化","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721383487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"之樞機，故曰天命。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721383487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"果老大仙夜觀星象，曰：論五行以為","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721399871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"指要，而成其文，能易曉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721399871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"且論天經地緯，夾拱不離者為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721416255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲寅生人，亥宫立","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721432639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"命，木在子，水居戍，命躔璧度，坐天門之上，此是經緯夾","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721432639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，今為商賈之人，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721432639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"果老聞之，一哂而言曰：子知其","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721449023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635859979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"一，不知其二。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721449023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"此水木分明，經緯然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721465407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"斯命坐於刼殺，水","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721481791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"漂白羊之宫，木入齊瓶之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721481791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"何況水木乃我所用，水為","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721498175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅之主，曜来傷才帛；木為官祿之用，星又損相貌；水","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721498175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"木又為宫度之主，得用受損，入格局破，何以槩論？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721498175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"若使","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721514559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"水子木戌，非此論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721514559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"經緯之理，餘氣可用。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721530943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"有辛夘生人，命","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721547327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"宫立命，木在寅，金在辰，木為天馬，金為地驛，二星得用","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721547327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"入垣，夾拱得地，此為上格；不尅不生、不破，此為中格；拱","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721547327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"来破局，失垣為下格，值斗杓指破者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721547327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017598177443892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：斗杓之地，立身安命，為富貴之良也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721563711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"有戊寅生人，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721580095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"正月巳時，酉上安命，坐斗柄之中，乃一寒儒，平生不富","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721580095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"不貴，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721580095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"果老曰：然，寒儒之格也，居於敗地，破碎地耗","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721596479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"守命得斗杓，為聰明文筆之士，若欲富貴科名，俟之皓","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721596479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"首無矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721596479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲戌十月丑時生，又寅宫立命值斗杓兼禄","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721612863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"貴長生，得局入格為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721612863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"貴命無貴禄，守命有生旺，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721629247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"為中格；有刼刄耗煞相刑則為下格，嫌值經緯破局。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721629247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：唐符國印二星守身命為竒，有丙辰生人，安命在","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721645631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017598177427508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，月在子，唐符在身，國印二星在命，不富不貴，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721645631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"荅","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721662015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：甲寅旬中，空亡之地，土空則崩，何富貴之有？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721662015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：隂注陽受，身命值之，則可化㐫為吉，更兼吉星，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721678399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"是利名之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721678399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"有庚辰生人，四月夘時酉土坐，命坐注","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721694783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"受之地，犯刑而死者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721694783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：此金為羊刄之煞，又值","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721711167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池，居于命宫，甲戌旬中無申酉，將何為美？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721711167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不為酒","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721727551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"色而害巳亡身也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721727551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：卦氣在身命宫者主榮，反為執鞭墜凳之人，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721743935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017626140704794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：可詳騐之，若非刼刄雄雌拱夾命位，亦是天耗地耗","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721760319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"守照身宫，要知用此為榮，則與斗杓相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721760319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：天馬、地驛吉㐫，何以叅詳？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721776703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：居垣入廟則吉，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721793087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"貴禄者為最妙，得長生旺相者尤竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721793087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌值空亡，不宜天","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721809471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"耗、地耗、休囚死絶，又忌戰衝刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721809471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：天地人三元禍福，何以取用？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721825855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：或為官禄之星，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721842239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"或㑹命度之主，或遇田財，㑹此之間皆美。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721842239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"當看十干𠮓","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721858623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，又看入垣升殿。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721858623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"且如三元皆㑹官福則為貴格，㑹田","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721875007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635941899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"財則是富翁，㑹度主滿用尤竒，中間駁雜，必細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721875007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：官禄主朝陽者，何如？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721891391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：格局髙強，更兼官禄朝","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721907775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，則為大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721907775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"若命元弱，度主朝陽，又何補焉？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721924159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：官禄","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721940543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"朝陽必富貴，安身傍母必尊榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721940543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：壽元星照本家，何以取斷？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721956927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：夀元星居于命位，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721973311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"宜臨禄貴生旺之方，方為吉論，不雜者尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721973311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":392,"lineType":9,"content":"五星先天口訣","logicSentenceId":"7679036168721989695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"先天心法者，老仙有先天之機，觀人之命而得於心，其","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722006079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635925515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"驗如神，故謂先天心法，不可輕以傳人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722006079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"推命之術，必在乎精，先觀主曜，次察身宫，以二十八宿","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722022463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"為經，用十一曜為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722022463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"尊莫尊於日月，美莫美於官福。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722038847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"貴","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722055231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"賤論煞，貧富論財。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722055231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"賢愚識其髙𤰞，壽天觀其元氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722071615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"此先","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722087999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"天之大要，更有口訣具列於後。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722087999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命泊尾十度至箕七度，以火水二星為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722104383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"其一木","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722120767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"同水入軫，月居井，日居昂，火入尾箕度𠔥夜生，此則一","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722120767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"品之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722120767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"得此者，主人呼吸若雷，身長大，性剛强，有威","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722137151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017619522256934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"權，四柱中有寅辰二字，謂之龍吟虎嘯，此人更生天地","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722137151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"之心，好山水之鄉，非凡之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722137151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"其次二曜朝陽，一星伴月，二品之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722153535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"其三火入奎樓，金水㑹翌軫，太乙抱蟾，𠔥以命主逢生，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722169919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"身主得垣，福禄不背，皆二品至五品之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722169919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"其四土火坐斗牛，長庚朝斗，水日坐天門，月到金牛，木","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722186303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"臨箕壁，金水朝陽，夜火逢陽於虚，五品至雜流也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722186303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"此上","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722202687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"皆有功名之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722202687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996227624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"其五，合前等星，或命度主，或官禄主受傷，或身命不髙，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722219071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"田財有好星拱夾，皆巨富之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722219071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"其六，身命稍入局，水木入命宮，醫卜之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722235455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"其七，羅星入命，刑煞坐髙者，武臣之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722251839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"其八，炁照身命，妻子官禄俱背，或命主入三宫，皆僧道","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722268223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722268223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"其九，身守遷移，主居三六，過房之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722284607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"其十，主在前，煞居後，身命受尅，八宫有惡星，皆賤疾之","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722300991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614635974667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722300991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"其十一，女人命須身宫清，夫宫净，水星入垣，子星好，大","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722317375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"富家婆之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722317375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"其十二，身宫陷，子宫陷，夫宫陷，水孛入命者，娼妓之命","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722333759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722333759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"其十三，又𠔥炁照身命，夫星受傷，子星被尅，師尼之命","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722350143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722350143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"其十四，身入遷移，孛羅計守命，夫宫受制，三嫁不休之","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722366527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017567957598259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722366527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"此先天之法，論命如鑒照形，得此者寳之，幸勿亂","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722382911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722382911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"老仙曰：我之與世遇無他，葢時𠮓人輕，不可與傳仙道，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722415679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"惟汝淳愿質朴可傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722415679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：仙道不願學也，但星命之中，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722432063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"願聞一二足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722432063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"仙曰：論命以斗杓、卦氣、唐符、國印、天雄、地雌為主，世俗","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722448447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"術士尚不能曉，何以知命？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722448447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"夫斗杓者，北斗之柄也；卦氣","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722464831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017583967060008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"者，天禄之餘也；唐符者，直年之星也；國印者，朝廷之印","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722464831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"也；天雄者，乾𧰼也；地雌者，坤𧰼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722464831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"如帝王命合局無斗","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722481215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"杓，不能致一人之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722481215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴命無卦氣，則安可食禄？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722497599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"武官","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722513983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符不得地，難握重權；正印、國印值空亡，到任而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722513983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"常","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722530367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"人命中皆有天雄、地雌、空亡的煞、天地二耗，此人上無","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722530367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"片瓦，下無頓錐之地，所以最為要緊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722530367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：願聞水死、","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722546751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"兵亡、蛇傷、虎噬，或縊死、雷傷，何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722546751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"老仙曰：又有刼","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722563135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"殺、亡神、驛馬貴人、破碎、貫索、桃花、浮沉、羊刄，皆要用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722563135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017614636007435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"且如命主星，身宫逢水孛、八煞，宫值浮沉、羊刃，又逢流","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722579519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"年水孛，必主溺水死。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722579519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"或身命坐羊刄，金火與命主同度，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722595903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"必主兵亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722595903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉、丑生人，安命寅宫，限逢計孛，必主虎咬。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722612287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉生人，已宫安命，蛇頭開口，限行鬼井，度逢火","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722628671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"羅。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722628671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":514,"lineType":2,"content":"又云火孛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇咬，可斷八煞。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722645055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"犯貫索，身命帯勾絞，限遇火金，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722661439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"主縊死。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722661439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐天厄，火入八宫，限行箕風，鬼金度，觜火度，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722677823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"必主雷傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722677823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：自幼從師，未嘗有此竒訣，敢問婦人出處去就，何","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722694207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017600224247849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"以取斷？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722694207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"老仙曰：福徳好，身宫清，夫宫帶禄。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722710591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌好，后妃","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722726975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722726975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌稍偏，亦夫人之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722743359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌好，夫宫雜，又坐","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722759743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花之地，娼妓命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168722759743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"或命主男女主同入夫宫，羅星守","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918269994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"命，此則帶子重嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918269994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"或夫主男女主同入命宫，入贅之𧰼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918286378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：敢問僧道命俱帶孤辰寡宿，何以知其為僧為道","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918302762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"之異？","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918302762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"老仙曰：玉函經云，問釋火宫辨别，求玄水位叅詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918319146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"盖僧命氣照身宫，火居命位，道家身居閑極，水入命元，","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918335530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"並帶孤辰寡宿，此其分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918335530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017598177509428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：富貴貧賤，盡知之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918351914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"窮通壽夭，在行乎限，願盡傳","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918368298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918368298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"老仙曰：此秘術不可轉傳於人，以泄漏天機，生則目","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918384682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"盲，死無棺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918384682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"憕曰：謹記。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918401066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"仙曰：世人都以官主論行限，十","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918417450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"不應一，可哂，可哂。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918417450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺行限，先依量天尺上按定坐宫，次","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918433834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"依洞㣲大限行去，專以生尅制化為窮通夀夭之别也。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918433834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"假如斗角奎井，安命以木為主，行四水度，或逢土，或遇","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918450218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"水孛，大發迹也，招廣財貴命，得此必進職加官。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918450218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"行心危","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918466602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"畢張度上，逢金亦好，逢火發達，逢土計喪服重重，午日麻","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918466602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996260392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"衣，灾晦不盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918466602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"行尾室觜翊度上，不宜見金，見金則有官","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918482986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"灾破財，或作土木造宅。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918482986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"行虚房星昴度上，平平，無灾無","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918499370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918499370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"行氐女胃栁度上，無灾，平坦發福，逢水孛驟發，逢金","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918515754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"決死。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918515754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"行牛亢婁鬼，大上大㐫，遇孛反主大發，決因禍而","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918532138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"致福，不宜見金，見金則死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918532138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"又如亢婁鬼牛度上，安命","logicSentenceId":"7679036168918548522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"以金為主，行四土度，大發；行四日度，平平，吉凶相半，必","logicSentenceId":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"五星自北而西，而南，而東，曰順行。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829064704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"順則面向於前，反","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829081088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"是則逆，逆則面反向後，皆看身命之所在，以辨諸星","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829081088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928412194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"向背拱夾之宜與不冝，不可槩以順者為帶。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829081088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帝","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829097472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之位，皆謂之旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829097472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"凢衰病死絶胎墓之位，皆謂之衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829113856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"身命星及得用之星坐臨其位，亦因之。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829130240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"哀旺之名，湏","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829146624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"是升殿居垣，方不以衰旺論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829146624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計闌截即掩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829179392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"曰月遇朔望則食。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829195776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"凢正朔之時刻，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829212160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"忌生四月度，雖無惡曜相闗，亦不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829212160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月前後三","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829228544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"日度內，引從夾輔，及三方對宫有吉星扶助者，反主","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829228544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017626140934170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，不可槩以蝕論為不祥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829228544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫有尅星曰衝，如","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829244928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"木在丑，金在未，正對之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829244928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"尅本命及身度之星曰制，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829261312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"如金為命，羅火制之。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829261312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"月為身，土計傷之之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829277696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"若讐害","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829294080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"之星，得此衝制，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829294080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計截諸星兩路，如文東武西之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829326848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"曰分。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829343232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星聚一","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829359616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"宫一度，如十一曜㑹聚身命官福田財。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829359616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"有生無尅曰","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829376000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829376000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"在前曰引，引宜度逺，如日月引從之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829392384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"在後曰從，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829408768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996375080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"從宜度近，如金水引從，宜水前金後之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829408768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"羅計攔截於身命宫之前後為截，吉星因是而皆行","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829441536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"於三宫六宫，則漏而無力矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829441536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：漏則身命所住之","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829457920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"位為守，十二宫交界之地為岐。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829457920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"凡身命坐度宜深，不","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829474304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"宜坐两岐。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829474304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"如命坐禄馬貴人地位之中，又得吉星拱","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829490688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"夾，真大貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829490688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"如坐两岐，多是隷卒之軰，否則必是","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829507072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"偏生庻出，𢃄遷移禄馬，乃過房出祖，奔走勞碌人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829507072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017638384042021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"若見有貴人坐两岐者，必時刻不定，切宜詳䆒。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829523456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：尊莫尊於日月。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829556224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"盖日月者，隂陽之精氣，諸星之","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829572608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"領䄂。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829572608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生從日，夜生從月，必是日月分明，吉星引從，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829588992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"方是真格，乃富貴之原也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829588992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"如日逢羅，木氣臨獅子，月","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829605376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"逢計，天乙趕月，及諸殺星侵犯日月，及日月居晦位，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829605376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"皆非吉論，雖或富貴，亦不逺大。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829605376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：貴人之命看日","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829621760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"月，日月分明是貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829621760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"玉衡經曰：晝生從日，喜居六陽","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829638144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928428578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫；夜生從月，利見六陰之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829638144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"果老云：晝生日，而金","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829654528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"水從陽，夜誕月而火羅侍衛。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829654528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"合而叅之，可見日月不","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829670912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"惟得地得時為明，而又必以得引得從為明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829670912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"七五","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829687296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：左右二殺月居中，仍看三曰宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829687296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"玉衡經云：三日","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829703680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"逢刑，總月地不能為福。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829703680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"由是推之，可見日月在命，不","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829720064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"惟本曰本宫，無殺星混雜為明，而又以日之前後三","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829720064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"度，以月之經行四十度之前後無妨礙者為明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829720064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829736448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：為君為父月、為后為母，身命官福近陽者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829736448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"日月","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829752832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017687474126911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"夾身，命夾官祿，及陰陽拱命者，皆得貴近君。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829752832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"若有㐫","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829769216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"殺及四餘間於其間，如君側之有讒人，雖貴不乆，雖","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829769216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"乆亦不顯矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829769216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"玉衡經云：背太陽，於父有憾；背太隂，於","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829785600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"母有虧。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829785600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"故身命二主向陽，則得父力，月明近命，則有","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829801984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"好母。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829801984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"反是，則不得於親，必早年棄背。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829818368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月雖向命，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829834752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"而又有㐫殺犯之，或晝月夜日，或寒月孤陽，父母雖","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829834752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"好，終是相失，與反背者同。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829834752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017638384058405"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：美莫美於福官。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829867520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"盖福星髙，則平生有財有福，而","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829883904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"百事皆集，無福則瓦觧矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829883904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"官星清，則為官有名有譽，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829900288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"而一身尊顯，否則碌碌無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829900288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"二星只要入命歸垣，近","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829916672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"陽得令，升殿入廟，無㐫殺衝制，方為發福，入仕好命，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829916672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰文星不若福星髙。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829916672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：格局髙強，不過官祿朝","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829933056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829933056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829949440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
