{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"命主即坐命處，二十八宿之所屬是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829982208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"身主即月也，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829998592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017687474143295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"及太陰所躔之度亦是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233829998592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"故星家有命度主、身度主","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830014976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"之辨，不可徒以命宫之主為命主，而月之所次之度","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830014976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"主亦不可舍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830014976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"果云身命得位，福祿難量，左右多情，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830031360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"功名有准。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830031360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：宫主州也，命主縣也，莫不自縣而州。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830047744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"愚常謂宫主猶人家也，度主猶家之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830064128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"一宫之內","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830080512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"大率有三等星度，猶一家之中子父兄弟不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830080512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"坐度","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830096896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"之星猶家主一人獨掌家務，則凡家人親友隨一人","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830096896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"之好惡為親踈。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830096896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"故度主是木，則以水為恩，以土為仇，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830113280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017607996407848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"以金為殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830113280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"若度主不是本，則又有别様好惡。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830129664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"譬之家","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830146048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"人之中，人殊則情亦殊，若只以一宫之主泛論禍福，","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830146048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"必無切驗。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830146048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"故知諸家論宫主而不論度主者，皆不若","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830162432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"果老之説為親切體要也。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830162432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"愚㫁以果老書為經，以諸","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830178816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"家為緯，以度主為先，以宫主為次，知所先後，則近道","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830178816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830178816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"身主諸家皆指為要𦂳，而果老月𠔥身命及身度","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830195200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"之主並用，尤為闗鍵。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830195200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"故傷身刼盗果老極忌，而對宫","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830211584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"水映蟾光者，必有異常之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830211584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"推此身主，身度主豈可","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830227968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017626140983322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"泛論？","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830227968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：　世人未識星家理，不務心傳務口耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830244352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"生時坐","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830260736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"度作虚名，只把命宫星作主。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830260736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽經緯何縱横，俗眼","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830277120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"無由見終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679038233830277120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"諸宫皆可論宫辰，命元切以度為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679038234004815924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679038234004832308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"是先生玄妙機，須得髙賢方説與。","logicSentenceId":"7679038234004832308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"一、日干弱，老年加殺必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650301988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"且如丙丁日干，年月時，庚辛","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650318372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"加酉運，或庚辛年，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650318372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日干，庚辛月時夾，雖未老，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650334756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"見庚辛必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650334756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"此條論三命法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官禄星宜守照身命，若化禄魁天地人，三元大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650351140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"一、恩主随身為富貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650367524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"假如坐四，土火為恩，與月同行，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650383908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"又是夜生，得令得時，更遇生旺，諸吉扶之，為一二三品","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650383908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650383908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰四月亥時，女土泊命，火炁月在畢行氐限，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650400292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017619522338854"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"輒登侍郎尚書，最怕土退行，縱有吉星為援，亦終不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650400292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"一、飛亷守命主夭，湏看格局髙強，有救有援，命亦可延。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650416676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子正月生人，命泊尾孛守照，土在命為援，亦不為","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650433060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899650433060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"又如室火安命，正月水為亷守照，若值太陽或木土","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766251526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫，反吉不為害。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766251526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":64, {"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八煞朝天。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766284294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"假如戌亥安命，金火獨守照，得令得時為","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766300678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766300678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"如泊命栁二三度，及翊亢泊命者，金火土𠔥為八","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766317062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179415588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，主獨去，占天門得所為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766317062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐刄，不宜金守照，加火羅愈惡，夀不延長。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766333446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"木命人","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766349830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"不得其死，逢空稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766349830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"一、流刄併天雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766366214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"遇木炁為煞最重，命坐四土，或坐四月","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766382598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"度者，或原月與木氣同躔，行限值刄炁有災，家口不寧。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766382598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"限雖不遇太隂，逐月行宫遇此刄炁，决主刑杖，或墜跌","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766398982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766398982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰刄氣在張，行限見之多災，流大隂遇之，同日","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766415366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"受杖八十。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766415366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"予命在女，炁月同度在亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766431750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰年壬辰月、戊","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766448134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017619522355238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"寅日，太隂值流炁，流木又在角，小限并刄值月宫符，大","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766448134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"限在氐值病符，原炁三方切照氐八度。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766448134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"忽髙樓跌下死，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766464518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"一日不知人事。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766464518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"炁月在刄值月宫，又難子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766480902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"一、月煞飛亷最要看。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766497286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"假如我命八月，月煞在亥，太𡻕","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766513670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"填實，本嫌炁月同躔室度，所喜炁生身度火，與彼有情，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766513670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"作事儘有方便，未免亦有險撞。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766513670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"一、㸔命不拘晝夜，須㸔太隂落在何度，有無夾拱，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766530054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"與命相叅取用。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766530054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"又看本生日干化曜，金木水火土加在","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766546438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017596738781225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"月上，與别曜有無尅制。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766546438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"假如我命甲子，曰干甲已土，太","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766562822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"隂即屬土，不宜月炁同躔，主有疾，炁為財福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766562822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"又日生人","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766579206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"稍輕行四月度，主脾胃疾，炁氣若帶殺，瘧疾，經年不愈，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766579206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"脱限外方可。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766579206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"一縊死，必犯闌干殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766595590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲戌生人，栁土泊命，土起亢羅","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766611974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"守照，一生發用，五十七限脱鋒入刼，自縊死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766611974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲寅生","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766628358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"人，寅時軫水立命，月起官禄，參水四度，十八嵗入張，為","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766628358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"生員縊死，以亢參度數是欄干故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766628358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"又如乙夘生人，壁","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766644742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017706558128165"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"水立命，日月夾水中，道士官𤰞至六十二行夘末，將入","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766644742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"刄縊死，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766644742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"葢宫火怒畢七，原欄干煞起，畢七與孛同","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766661126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"道，命水又是廉刼主，不宜夾拱，亦主縊死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766661126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"不獨㸔欄干，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766677510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"cont {"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"一、五星帶天雄羊刄，近太陽，主目疾，四日泊命愈，驗日","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766890502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"守照亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766890502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"若日帶孤亷刃守照，或遇殺星輔夾，俱主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766906886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"一、用星或命或官本弱，得援星親切得所者為上。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766923270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐孤刼，有孤刼星守照者，有命帶孤刼者，不可一","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766939654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"概論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766939654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵身命帶從坐煞，孤刼逄生，必害六親，各有輕","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766956038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"重得失之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766956038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017687474241599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐四金度，土對照，金勢強，假使金木同度，或躔木","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766972422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"宿者，既尅為財主，一生有財，及至行限與金木同度，决","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766972422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"然不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766972422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"因財致禍，刑煞重併者者尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899766988806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看命度帶煞與不帶煞，起在何宫度，與三方有無相","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767005190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，方論吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767005190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"假使金為命度，又是亷刄等煞，或與火羅","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767021574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"衝戰，或與太隂同道，決主重疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767021574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶孤刄，亦主孤乏。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767037958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767054342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞升殿居垣，更加三元㑹，此皆是顯達上格，餘皆倣","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767054342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767054342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691086962722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八煞煞宫刄雄併，或身命坐臨此宫，或煞星臨照此","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767070726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，皆主重疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767070726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"八煞主守照得所，主權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767087110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字中諸刼刄併在年時上，主疾，否則天。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767103494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"若諸吉貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767119878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"禄注受斗杓符印，在年日時上大吉貴，如甲辰、甲子、甲","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767119878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"申，九月、十一月，注受禄馬，生旺在寅，寅時最好。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767119878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火帶帶刄鋒，行限遇之，或太嵗加臨，主血毒灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767136262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"金帶","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767152646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"鋒刄，主喘，肺中有疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767152646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928461346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"一、天元星，最要𦂳，或守命得令相資，或是身命主聰明，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767185414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"加生旺貴禄為竒，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767185414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"一、行限見夫妻星，又吉曜得令，主有喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767201798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"行度交送，見之","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767218182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉有㐫，生我者吉，尅我者㐫，如井木行室火，為脱氣","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767218182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767218182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"一同年月日時之命，出處不同，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767234566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"想太隂交宫過度","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767250950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深先後有八刻之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767250950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"假如前四刻月在心五度，論太","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767267334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"隂行事，後四刻月到尾初，論火取用，各有不同，况夜生","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767267334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179448356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"人乃身度主為要，因往推來可騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767267334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"一、三元最宜照官禄，若安命在奎婁，更天元星得令，得","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767283718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"地㑹官福，必中進士狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767283718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命坐空，怕刃對照，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767300102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"行限見㐫星難過。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767316486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"坐命對","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767332870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"生時，又遇殺守照，夀不長。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767332870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"一四金泊命，主起煞宫，盖煞氣太重，命不乆長，若福禄","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767349254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"身好發用，只宜引陽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767349254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"一、冬令金水嚴凝，若守照或是命度，乃孤乏之人也，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767365638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691086946338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767365638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"一、飛亷守照，夀不延。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767382022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰命，八月寅時，張度泊命，亷","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767398406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"火守照，日有辛巳、戊午之不同，一為進士侍郎，始終得","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767398406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"所，一為監生，至五旬方除州判，過三載死在途。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767398406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"又如庚","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767414790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"辰三月未時，星曰泊命，火羅為亷，與曰同度，父夀未限","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767414790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767414790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"又有三月寅時命坐室，孛守火羅夾陽行房曰度，有","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767431174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"夭者，有夀者，六十甲子中皆類此。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767431174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"觀命者不可執一經，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767447558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"泥一途，當權通𠮓化，固㣲妙而難測也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767447558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"吾想夫午宫安","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767463942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017687474257983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"命者，火官為福，為天地元，總是太陰之力。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767463942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"又如彭布政","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767480326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"命，已未正月亥時，角木泊命，孛守角木貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767480326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰火命","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767496710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"人，如何不怕孛，孛又是亷刼主，只因五星髙強反吉論，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767496710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"孛生命木故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767496710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"一、計羅截斷論，跳出一星，又嫌五殘守照，經書甚有理，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767513094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"但中間多有五殘守照而富貴者，如白布政已亥四月","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767513094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"二十九日子時，危十二度泊命，計羅辰戌滿，一炁在斗，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767513094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"木到大梁，月孛胃土同躔，諸星皆不可取，年少登髙科，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767513094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017706558177317"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"得名為御史、副使、布政，人品異常。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767513094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"吾想月為天元祿，主","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767529478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"身度，主起髙故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767529478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳亥七月卯時，柳上泊命炁滿","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767545862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"闗，日月五星拱夾，早妨父母出外，無根發迹，此格可准。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767545862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"又有六月午時，氐土安命五星曰月南離趨拱，此是貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767562246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767562246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"又如已亥八月十四日午時，寅尾安命，炁在斗，月在","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767578630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"危，脱氐土身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767578630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"吾想月帶刃推，不宜與火已亥對衝，加","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767595014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"金羅三方對照，謂三方四正俱是煞故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767595014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太乙抱鬼之説，鄭先生曾論有秋殘夜半不可孤居","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767611398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017638384123941"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"之論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767611398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"吾觀貴命多有月孛同行，或前或後，或沉或晦，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767627782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"在辰戌丑宫者不妨，此又不可一槩而取。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767627782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人命最難看，有坐臨官馬者，有坐咸池守照者，身","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767644166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"星清吉，亦無它事，雖發用，一生多病，若煞宫安身命，終","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767644166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"帶妨尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767644166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"一、女土泊命，木守照不妨，行限好，即發用，財福尅命之","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767660550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"故。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767660550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看太隂要緊，李侍郎巳已十二月十四日亥時，程副","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767676934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017687474274367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"使十三日亥時，俱翌火度泊命，監生舉人出身。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767676934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星無","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767693318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"異，止是月躔畢度者，一生為風憲官，五十八致仕，富貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767693318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"極厚，七十一死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767693318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"月躔井一者，一生為部官，五十九病，六","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767709702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"十死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767709702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"又如乙夘八月辛丑日申時，金月在辰，又有已亥","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767726086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"日申時者，二命俱坐虚，日孛守照，諸星一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767726086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂與木","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767742470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"日在巳者，早中進士、御史、侍郎、尚書，五子三子貴夀，至","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767742470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"六十發背死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767742470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":338, {"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"一㸔八字要緊，如時遇祿馬生旺貴人，或坐時籍之勲，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767791622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"皆好，甲辰坐寅時尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767791622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星拱西北，惟一月順而當陽，宫度俱强，亦為大格，","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767808006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"行限弱則不能吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767808006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬申四月亥時在斗泊命，壬戌日","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767824390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"者月坐官，禄坐殿，官至一二品。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767824390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑日者月坐福徳，官至","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767840774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"四品三品，俱六十二行入午限死。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767840774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽酉孤立，癸酉流","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767857158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"年，羊刄在命，俱死于官。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767857158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"得唐符卦氣在午，結果甚美。","logicSentenceId":"7679033899767873542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426920979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928526882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"加壬申正月巳時，胃土泊命，計羅巳亥一孛滿用月與日","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426920979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"在亥者，登進士，官至三品，一子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426920979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"月在八煞者為生員，無","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426937363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"子，三十五入刄病亡，重在太隂，不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426937363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"一、論拱北格，如黄少𡖖甲戌年正月二十七日夘時生，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426953747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"水木日守命在室，度五十六限，氏土死在途，此火水之","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426953747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426953747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"又有同年月時二十八日生者，作二月節注受在","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426970131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"亥更妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426970131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"月金同度在子，格局拱北，何以為守藝下賤人","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426986515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"命也，重在日之干支，可見丁夘戊辰之有異，不可執五","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426986515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017596738813993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"星便斷貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066426986515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"若不精八字者，須熟知人出處，先人事有","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427002899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"准，方㫁後吉㐫庶可。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427002899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火羅攻破，日䑕者，太陽得所，火羅不得令，或水土生","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427019283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"人，不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427019283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人丁巳正月申時生，羊刄地雌在命，孛為鋒亷㑹","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427035667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"羅炁守夾井木命木又躔亢，劒殺坐奴囚刑，左右拱夾，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427035667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"何以取用？","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427035667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知羅孛乃為我用，星計為官魁，夫主朝","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427052051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"天太貴，一品夫人造化壽八十之上，八字有天月二徳","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427052051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179497508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427052051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"一、玄武引駕，水在日前，又值吉神，化三元最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427068435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗兼","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427084819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"之為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427084819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"四、水泊命者取之，在午未辰巳夘上愈妙，更","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427101203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"要太陽得地有光。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427101203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"一、朱雀朝天，或捧御單行得令為上格，化三元最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427117587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427133971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌亥安命，火守化為三元，或木又為三元，三元宫度","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427133971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"相資為上格也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427133971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"一、昴日安命，刄火與日同躔，木㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427150355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢夜生，秋冬不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427166739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691087028258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"更得金水相扶，亦主貴有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427183123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"一、宫主尅度輕，八殺不宜尅命，官福主受尅限，遇之不","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427248659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691087011874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427248659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"格局好，雖不妨，結果終不善。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427265043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"一、土計羅帶天雄，羊刄夜生，與月共度，必有破相之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427281427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽帶之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427297811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"一、丁酉十月丑時巳翊泊命，金守照，月與火同度，在軫","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427314195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"十二三，必是瞽者。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427314195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"金能音樂，月帶刄殺最不宜，火逼故","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427330579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427330579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命入八煞，得令得時，諸吉扶之，貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427346963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁夘生五","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427363347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"月午時軫十度泊命，羅計截斷寅申，一金漏出在酉本","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427363347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017583967256616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"美，争奈火助煞，土尅命，水在鬼，月帶刄，同木坐禄旺，見","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427363347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"水得子妨妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427363347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"三十五行井木净身為內使，刄尾刼首見","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427379731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"計不好，總論一金得力故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427379731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"假如戌亥子立命，八煞守","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427396115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"照，更遇吉神，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427396115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星皆晦，惟一福專權，又化為催官，或為三元，又值","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427412499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"禄旺之地，不以晝夜為忌，此是大格局。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427412499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有官禄從陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427428883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"若在弱宫，與命相戰，皆不取用，與身命相資者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427428883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"一、犯三刑勾絞，如夘刑子，是子上泊命者，八字日支又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427445267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179513892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"是子日者，四旬外行夘限，犯刑而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427445267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丑刑戌，身命","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427461651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"主起在戌上，又日支是戌，再行煞地，必犯刑死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427461651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"不相干，犯行煞限，或獄中死，或生毒死，守星善善死，犯","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"者終非是吉人。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427478035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命坐劒廉，刄鋒無星壓者，若星得局，主發用貴顯，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427494419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"限遇諸殺井沓重者，亦主死于非命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427494419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"行煞地或見㐫","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427510803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"星，火羅計孛，發惡瘡死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427510803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"又如坐有吉星，限遇煞交併，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427527187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"主横死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427527187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"有壬申生人，七月夘時，星日泊命，水輔陽在午，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427543571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928559650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"唐符卦氣在局，中年保為訓導。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427543571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉流年，六十二嵗，限","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"交室火見計，六月被同僚打死檢屍，此是羊刄與木對","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"照于命申反刑亥，加勾絞，亡神貫索在亥，炁月在丑，羅","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"土在巳酉，諸煞交攻故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427559955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"一、安命立身坐，實占髙強。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427576339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"且如六辛生人，酉上泊命，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427592723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉日最佳。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427592723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"若身命福，禄星好，一二品格，戌為刄處安","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427609107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"命，遇戌亥日㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427609107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐日支為第一，坐年月時者次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427625491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427641875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"如金生在巳遇巳巳日又是巳上安命，文星旺官髙。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427641875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427658259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928543266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"如木旺在夘，又遇夘日，更安命在夘，大貴之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427658259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字有合，天月二徳，命度身好，大貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427674643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"或時帶天月","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427691027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"二徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427691027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"假如巳生人，寅戌為天月二徳，日月時有寅戌又","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427707411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"相合為竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427707411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字天亡，先論日干支要𦂳，假如乙酉日，便不宜庚","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427723795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時，謂羊刄交合故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427723795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四月泊命，月起失經土計或羅孛帶殺夾拱，夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427740179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427756563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"水雖好，若帶重煞交拱，亦不乆長。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427756563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺太隂只宜獨居","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427772947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725205938239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"夜深，火金與月助光相宜，帶天元中舉，與孛同躔，妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427772947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"若有坐位，巳不妨，寒月不可同居。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427789331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"一、孛隨火後行，大限忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427805715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"若四火安命，或火命人生壽","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427822099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"不長，火旺尤可，隔二三度主夭，十六度外有援亦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427822099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四木安命，木土同度得躔，又得生旺，財帛擁進，更財","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427838483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"福二官有吉星扶為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427838483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四木安命，水去輔日引駕，更得吉曜相扶，太嵗兼之，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427854867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427854867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691087093794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四土安命，宜火得令，獨居守照，或去近土為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427871251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"再","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427887635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜近羅，謂逢生不宜重見。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427887635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"若火太燥為下格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427904019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"一、四日泊命，不宜木炁與日同躔，日生人主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427920403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"若火羅","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427936787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"日同躔，只不益尊親，於巳不妨，惟四日不怕飛亷火。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427936787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"一、帶華盖，主聰明，宦官帶華盖者多。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427953171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"一、妻坐遷移，昭重婚之婦遷移主，亦不宜守照。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427969555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命坐孤刼，無吉星輔者，結果欠好，縱有福禄星享","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427985939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"用，到㡳不得力，或死在外方，不見妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066427985939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"面煞宜空，福禄","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428002323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017670965198875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星不宜空。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428002323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看命格最要𦂳，中間星辰有吉有㐫，且如火羅計孛","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428018707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"守辰戌丑未，或月坐煞得地，先貴後刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428018707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐旺地，行庫限不吉，或死亡，或剥官，有援不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428035091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"一、壬癸生人，土為羊刄，又為血支血忌，若四水或月度","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428051475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"安命，土計尅度，主血光灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428051475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"如是五六月為飛亷，必主天。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428067859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰金命生人，見土不甚㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428084243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"一、坐天狗，主無子，如癸酉五月未時命坐角，丁酉日者，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428100627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017674794614784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"木月同度在室，有子無官。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428100627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌日者，月躔壁水，有官無","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428117011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428117011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"予想身度主朝天，月為天狗，得水光彩，所以無子有","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428133395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428133395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"又有坐天狗者，加火孛，不吉，照命限，必然無子。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428149779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"若得","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428166163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星者，又當有子，不可執一論之。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428166163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗在男女宫主受","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428182547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，亦難子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428182547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐處對生時，時又帶煞，主夭難養。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428198931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太嵗填實，惡星或在命限，主灾，犯者死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428215315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"一、兩岐斷躔處立命天，否則貧乏，坐處不得安稳故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428231699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725205971007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"假如乙夘九月十四日戌亥時生人，胃，十一、十四五度","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428248083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"泊命，殊不知戌亥時胃炁盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428248083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"又入昴初管事，最忌火","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428264467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"羅為鋒，若太陽坐煞，或犯火羅，此命十三先尅父，十四","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428264467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"後尅母，交限斷躔故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428264467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿交界處，有盈有虧，須","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428280851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"考究推斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428280851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"一共命，貧富壽天不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428297235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"吾觀時有八刻，刻內有卒風暴","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428313619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"雨，隂晴晦朔，是一箇時中有𠮓兩三様天氣，更有日月","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428313619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"循行，交宫過度，明晦不一，雖曰共時，其刻有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428313619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"天時","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428330003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691087110178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"人身相合，未免争差。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428330003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"有彷彿者，時刻相去不逺。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428346387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"出處","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428362771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"大不同者，初未交界故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428362771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"一經云：官禄宫主，忌限天雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428379155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"有戊辰生人，正月酉時張","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428395539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"七度安命，土守照，月傷女土金日在危，謂犯天雄，如何","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428395539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"行酉限？","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428395539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"官至三品，入魁二品，六十五升兵部尚書，七十","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428411923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"致仕，盖木命人不畏土故也，貌主黑。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428411923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"一經云：四月坐命，惟土計可怕。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428428307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"有辛夘生人，十月十五","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428444691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"戌時畢十三度坐命，土月同躔在夘，二十六中進士，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428444691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179563044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"四十六二三品盡是水日在邜，謂玄武引駕。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428444691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生人用","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428461075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"身度昴日為主故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428461075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"然土為八煞，遷移退行，與月有情，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428477459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"母子先零丁被㐫人刼去，後顯復性，與母同居。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428477459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"一、男女宫見太隂并金水，先得女子，羅計在五宫，主執","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428493843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"拗性情，多有尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428493843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢木土太陽，主先生男，如夜值之，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428510227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"恐難存養。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428510227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"一、孛在前，月在後，謂太乙抱鬼，亥戌丑宫在下弦既晦","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428526611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，名曰抱死鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428526611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"有乙酉生人，九月三十日辰時尾初","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428542995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928592418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"立命，金水守照，月角八亢初，謂抱死鬼，月又在亢八，父","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428542995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"早亡，母賢，夀至四十一，行張限為御史。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066428542995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"四十八，四品。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590498870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"行","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590515254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"至栁土，三品。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590515254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"其説何如？","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590531638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水日馬官魁，金水月孛俱旺","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590548022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"樂，孛為禄主故也，術者不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590548022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"一、水氣相生夾命，或帶官禄為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590564406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"一、羅近太陽，父凶，殊不知又有夀考者，謂首星捧日，夜","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590580790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"生者吉，盖夜日無光，喜火羅故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590580790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"一、經云：八煞宫𠔥閑極，身命所臨皆不取。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590597174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"楊監生甲辰","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590613558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017596738846761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"三月戌時亢金坐命，土資亢大守照，為天池人，三元有","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590613558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"學，四十四脱鬼金死，在途無子，件件無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590613558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"况金為廉鋒，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590629942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"夜土木愈凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590629942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲辰七月已時亢坐命，土資亢木在角，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590646326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"金拱日，貧乏之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590646326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"如殿駕馬者，不可泥此論。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590662710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"一、對宫星為大耗，見之主服耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590679094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"如我命女度，土見日，大","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590695478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"耗加官，如李廉使命，土見日，升三品，死六人。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590695478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"一、身命起死敗地，行衰限破家，行限見敗星，或天地耗，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590711862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"又對宫大耗，皆耗財。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590711862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691087126562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火羅計孛中居子午，與四餘並論。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590728246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"一、殺星坐命，不喜殺星來生他，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590744630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲辰生人，亢度","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590761014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"立命，金帶劔鋒或飛廉，最不宜土來亢上，葢其為白虎","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590761014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"的殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590761014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"若身吉，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590777398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"若火羅孛犯身，主賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590793782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"四十五行鬼金","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590810166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"煞則死。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590810166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命度帶刼刅廉的耗，符殺併重，又遇生星，其勢愈惡，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590826550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"行殺限夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590826550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸未五六月生人女土安命者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590842934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"一四水安命，遇金帶長生貴禄守照，或生水大吉，愈老","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590859318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017647179595812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"愈徤。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590859318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸酉生人，金帶鋒廉守照，雖生貴水亦夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590875702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官命二宫會注，受斗杓卦殿，生旺本吉，然本原受𧇊，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590892086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"名利虚花，百無一成。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590892086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"看楊知縣戊戌命便知不吉，主夭，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590908470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"子不成人。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590908470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"一、水為孤，刼計為雄，刄夾日，主胎中妨父，刄雌與太隂","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590924854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"合着度上即妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590924854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"一、八字忌惡日生，經云：倉庫化作塵，無格者凶時亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590941238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"吾觀大富貴命，多有十惡日生者，此不可准。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590957622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017691928625186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"一、三竒格主者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590974006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"曾觀不富不貴命，亦有甲戌庚子丙","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590990390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"丁者，意日時上起者准。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066590990390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官星最怕天雄，如孫尚書戌辰生張立命，土守照，金","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591006774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"日月在子，天雄不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591006774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"一、行限遇忌星當亡，若限主忌曜居旺樂廟，止是病，再","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591023158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"延四年或一二年。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591023158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸亥生人，命在心水，土在刼尾，七","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591039542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"十一病幾死，又踰十四行昴度方死，其類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591039542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"一、流年星如井木安命，木入亢婁，火帶煞入命，宜謹身","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591055926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017638384156709"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"節欲。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591055926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"一、土躔牛，居垣而泄氣，木𨇠斗，入廟而退行。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591072310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"得失相半。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591088694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"一、奴入官宫，煞臨命主，人事虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591105078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"一、木土同度，入子限，便有耗服。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591121462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"一諸星背行，亦有隠匿而不知顯者，如已亥生人，四月","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591531062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"子時危十二度，命坐計羅，辰戌截炁在斗，諸曜皆西没","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591531062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，孛隨月後，俱傷於胃木，又大梁行限，似不可取。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591531062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591547446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"人二十五中進士、御史，三十四五副使、布政，四十四五","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591547446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"侍郎、尚書。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591547446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"葢身命月為天元，與孛在胃正旺之地，火金","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591563830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"為官魁，前後引從，此大格也。","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591563830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"五十七行氐度死，","logicSentenceId":"7679034066591580214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
