{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"一身坐奴僕有吉有㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135335999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之格多是身𡿨主，入奴僕","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135352383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"而貴者，亦有入奴僕而賤者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135352383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"如奴僕宫主原是六馬貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"人、長生帝旺、駕殿祿勲之地，皆不可以奴僕論，皆為國","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759737724968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"出力大貴之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"如奴僕宫，原是的殺、羊刄、亡神、飛亷、死","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"絶、暴敗之鄉，而身命主又陷其上，此是奔走服役，奔波","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"無成之人，方以奴僕言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"一奴僕不獨轄人貴賤勞𨓜，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135401535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主僕馬侍從。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135401535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"本星坐於強旺之地，更加吉星出之，必","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135417919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"主僕馬豐盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135417919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"若主星弱，奴星強，反被奴僕欺害。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135434303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"果老云：","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135450687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"主弱奴強，奴僕有侵凌之患，大扺以身命髙強為上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135450687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"一妻宫是禄貴、長生、帝旺之地，皆主好妻，及羙貌多能。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135483455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017786623148032"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻宫是死絶、的殺、刼殺、暴敗，皆不得好妻，更㑹孤寡","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135499839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"惡宿，必主無妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135499839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"術家所云鼓盆星五行絶位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135516223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹䘮","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135532607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"弔二符、計都，必尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135532607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星是殺星，坐強坐實，或殿駕，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135548991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"或守田宅，守財帛者，主妻多做大規模，欺凌夫主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135548991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以日為夫妻，但年月日時多一干者，為犯重婚，故","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135565375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩甲兩妻之説。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135565375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"五星專以妻妾宫主星，㸔其空實、弱","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135581759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"強生尅之理以明之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135581759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135598143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"第宫主落空，亡居弱地，有的","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"殺、六害、白虎加其宫分，及臨其主所守之地者，必多尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725206102079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"害。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星化直，難坐咸池、的殺同宫，必多産厄而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135630911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星是太隂坐未，或在午，或入兄弟宫，多主因親致親，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"或姨兄弟為之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"或妻星单坐華盖及陽刄我命宫坐白","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135663679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"虎者，則多與妻不和隔角之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135663679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星落陷，若得餘氣","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135680063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"有力，必有小妻偕老。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135680063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"　又如妻星坐咸池，與兄弟主、奴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"僕主同宫，又有的殺、驛馬夾之者，則主其妻與外人及","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕通情者，極驗，不可不信。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人尅夫，亦以兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135712831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"主星依次條㫁之，萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135712831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"一、官祿不要煞星尅其宫，名曰官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135958591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"如官祿在亥，却不","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135974975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"宜金星入內，亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135974975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"三合四正宫值之，皆主其人徤訟，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135991359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017670965477403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"不然遭官破家，亦主其人無官食祿之分。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135991359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"諸宫皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260198436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"看官祿宫，不宜財星生旺守照，及犯天雄羊刄惡星，主","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260214820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"人貪財壞名，亦不喜官星尅命。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260214820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：官祿尅命，以名立","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260231204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"身，以名喪身。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260231204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"更不喜十宫逢羅，主人粗豪徤訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260247588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看命須先看福徳為要。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260280356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人生處世，以福為最，有福","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260296740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"則以立妻子，立名利，致富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260296740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳既虧前數者，未見其","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260313124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"可得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260313124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"福宫者，人生之主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260329508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"若福祿居福，身主命，主入福，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260345892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017685280505897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"又有日月照福徳，權貴蔭印諸星照福，金水夾月居福，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260345892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"皆是有福之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260345892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"為人性必端厚，量必寛洪，仁慈處世無","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260362276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"尅薄之患，亦主有夀，可以定人之性情。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260362276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"每試累騐，若同","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260378660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"土計生福徳者，其人必寡言語，性沉重。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260378660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"若福徳有刑囚","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260395044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"耗星居其上者，其人必是尅薄之徒，兇狼之輩，大寛小","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260395044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"急，不仁不義之流，心多奸偽，言不忠信，詭譎欺詐之徒，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260395044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1130,"lineType":1,"content":"奸謀機巧之輩，未見其為有福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260395044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1130,"lineType":1,"content":"如福徳無好星，又看三","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260411428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"方對照，有何星照之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260411428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"如三合對照守照俱無，未便言其","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260427812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017670965493787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶，更看財帛何如，以消詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260427812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1158,"lineType":1,"content":"金星獨行，相貌清秀温潤。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260558884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1158,"lineType":1,"content":"木星瘦長清爽。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260575268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1158,"lineType":1,"content":"水星眼目俊。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260591652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"火星日生則面紫黑，夜生則紅白。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260608036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"土星肥白長大，夜生","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260624420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"則矮黑。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260624420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星則額角骨露，日生長大好顔色，夜生顴骨","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260640804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"露而細小。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260640804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋頭額濶大，骨格粗，多鬍鬚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260657188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"計長大，面骨","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260673572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"粗露，夜則身小而眼露。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260673572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"炁星好相貌，多髭。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260689956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂温潤肥","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260706340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"白，夜黑小。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260706340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽日生黒色赤，夜生清白𡙁氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260722724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看相貌，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260739108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496471076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"如命裏有星，須看先入者斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260739108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"若命與相貌皆有星，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260755492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"依術斷之，及三合對照推之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260755492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"主星起㑹刑囚暗煞，主破","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260771876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"相暗疾，不然雕花刺文之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260771876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"女命以對宫夫星為主，看夫星起在何宫，得位得所，或","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260804644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星坐之，或從陽三方對照，加吉星者，必嫁好夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260804644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"可隨人","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260821028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"盤逐宫推看入官禄得地，主有貴夫人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260821028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳，主夫有福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260837412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"入財帛，主夫有財。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260853796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"入兄弟，主見棄相嫌，恐與兄弟有情。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260870180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725206151231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"入田宅，主夫有業。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260886564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"入男女，主有子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260902948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"入奴僕，主勞碌，喜","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260919332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"為庖厨，或與僕通。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260919332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"入七宫，或因親而成。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260935716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"入疾厄，主夫有","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260952100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260952100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"入遷移，主夫逺出離祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260968484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"入相貌，主夫有貌。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848260984868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"入命宫與","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261001252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星加臨，得用相生，冨貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261001252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"又㸔得經失經如何，或","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261017636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"加煞，或加四，餘逐宫推㸔，恐三方對照，吉㐫如何，不可","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261017636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"槩論，須㸔坐命度主宫，主起在何方，皆一細推十二宫","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261017636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主星有用與否。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261017636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"一、女命必看身主如何，女人最要身清吉，不可駁雜，金","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261034020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278599690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"水相從太隂則吉，逄惡星則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261034020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"又看人盤得所，不可執","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261050404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"論，逐宫推之則可。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261050404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"忌三方血刄加㳫，計羅照命，或沓在","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261066788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"刃宫，或守照，必主血氣疾亡，大忌飛刄逄交破。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261066788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"凡丁已生人，太隂以作刄主論，逢飛亷大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261083172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"次看福主","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261099556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"如何，福主失經，入弱宫必無福，入強宫得所，生平有福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261099556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人命坐驛馬，又帶水孛照命照身，或在五弱之宫，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261115940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"主其人滛奔，其與男子同斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261115940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人不宜太陽坐命照命，加以身強，皆主欺夫奪權，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261132324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725206167615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"性急有男子之志。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261132324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"一、娼妓之命，必犯桃花、計孛、金孛、水孛，福徳必不好，夫","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261148708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"星必陷，夫宫必駁雜，相貌宫必好，男女宫必傷犯惡星。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261148708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"一、凡婦人天馬地驛守命者，滛。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261165092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"一、婦人忌四餘主旺，皆主重婚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261181476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"月孛當頭，伶俐太過，尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261197860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"夫害子，猶有醜聲，多滛下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261197860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"若命坐咸池者，必滛行限","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261214244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之，滛而凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261214244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"土孛滛穢，金炁無擇。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261230628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"水火滛而刑，火土孤","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261247012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"孀。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261247012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"或男女星陷而得地，又當生貴子，而有好稱呼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261263396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209291827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"星命溯源卷五","logicSentenceId":"7679033848261279780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1603/12/ref/1m1emxus2gras/1-SK1603_figure_00002.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FBVIIn7fRi0bI23Z%2BGs2DKaXHEM%3D","pictur
